pages.text: The synthetic forge is the typical crafting block for creating new body parts or augments. It needs to be filled with lava, which can be done with a bucket or other methods. Any ingredients for a recipe can then be placed in the grid. Without a blueprint, a player with the required research must be present for the recipe to begin crafting.

The blueprint is a way to automate the Synthetic Forge. You can place a blueprint in the top right slot, if that blueprint is empty and a recipe is completed, the required research for that recipe will be saved onto the blueprint, and it can be used instead of a player's presence to start that recipe.
